# ConnectorRow

Lists what the agent is actually wired into — the trust surface of the product.

`SuDuAI.ConnectorRow` · AI

## Use

```jsx
<SuDuAI.ConnectorRow icon="…" name="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SuDuAI.ConnectorRow" icon="…" name="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

One integrated data source or tool bound to the current agent session.

## Props (ConnectorRowProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` * | `string` | Material Symbols glyph, 18px, in a raised tile. |
| `name` * | `string` |  |
| `detail` | `string` | Single muted line, e.g. "pool: payment-master-eu". |
| `meta` | `string[]` | Bullet-separated label-sm facts, e.g. ["Ping: 1.2ms", "SSL/mTLS Valid"]. |
| `state` | `string` | Badge text, e.g. "Connected", "Active", "Ready". |
| `stateTone` | `'neutral' \| 'accent' \| 'tertiary' \| 'error'` | Badge tone. Default "accent". |
| `iconColor` | `string` | Glyph color — vary per connector class. |
